correctness.rationale: All 20 bidegree-(4,3) coefficients over F2 and all nine rational evaluation constraints are exactly enumerated; the resulting kernel has rank 9, size 2048. The 2047 nonzero forms are exhausted under the 36-element ruling-preserving group, producing 99 orbits. Exact four-chart Jacobian Groebner unit-ideal tests yield precisely four smooth orbits of sizes 6,18,36,6. An independently structured lexicographic check runs on every nonzero form and reproduces 66. Stabilizer element orders prove C6,C2,1,S3. Two finite-field implementations with distinct extension-field polynomial choices agree on all four six-degree point-count vectors; genus-six Newton recurrences and functional equation give the four displayed degree-12 Weil numerators. Smooth positive bidegree implies geometric irreducibility by the intersection pairing.

value.rationale: The exceptional F2 bidegree-(4,3) split-quadric filling problem is canonical and minimal by Homma--Kim. The literature constructs one curve but leaves the full smooth locus and its arithmetic distribution undetermined. The exact 66-curve, four-orbit classification, different ruling-preserving symmetry types and pairwise nonisogenous Jacobians answer that motivated natural classification question. The theorem does not merely rename a known example or calculate an arbitrary slice.
